rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.GLOSS: The immaterial part of a person; the animating force of life; the Holy Spirit.
content.ART_PROMPT: Ethereal swirling wind and golden light forming a vague dove shape amidst chaotic waves, glowing atmosphere, divine presence, digital painting style
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Choose between Tower, Sheol, or Opponent's Hand. Reveal up 5 cards from the chosen location and take any number of them.
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Job 33:4 — “The Spirit of God has made me; the breath of the Almighty gives me life.”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: 2 Corinthians 3:6 — “...for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: Hebrew 'ruach' and Greek 'pneuma' both mean wind, breath, and spirit.
The Spirit is often symbolized by a dove, fire, wind, or water.
In the Old Testament, the Spirit empowered individuals for specific tasks; in the New, He indwells believers.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left). EXACT CARD TYPE: TITLE. The internal top-left badge must print that exact type label and its matching white icon. EXACT RARITY: RARE. REQUIRED COST: plus one printed card icon. Copy complete geometry from reference [1]. Render every supplied field exactly once. All Hebrew/Aramaic, Greek, transliterations, glosses, senses, testament columns, and references are immutable canonical data: copy verbatim; never translate, paraphrase, approximate, decorate, or substitute them. Never print placeholder, schema, field-name, or instruction labels such as DEFINITION TEXT, GLOSS, ART PROMPT, TYPE, or TRANSLIT.
